patch_description: This design uses a soft, demand-based routing proxy rather than rewarding a fixed number of two-hop paths in isolation. For each OD pair, it selects up to two low-pressure transit nodes, then estimates how much traffic those routes would expose each directed link to. That exposure informs both a modest link reward and sparse positive couplings between heavily exposed links sharing an endpoint, approximating local load balancing. Two-hop rewards remain, but are discounted by the estimated route pressure; a small reciprocal-link penalty discourages unproductive backtracking without forbidding useful mutual links.
